status: DEMO ONLY — NIOSH EQUATIONS, PENDING OCCUPATIONAL-SAFETY REVIEW

source.title: Criteria for a Recommended Standard: Occupational Exposure to Heat and Hot Environments

transcription_method: Limits computed from NIOSH 2016-106 section 8.1 equations (printed p.93): RAL = 59.9 - 14.1 log10 M, REL = 56.7 - 11.5 log10 M, M in watts (1 kcal/h = 1.163 W), at the class upper-edge workload. For w work minutes per hour, M is the 1-hour time-weighted average (w*M_task + (60-w)*117 W)/60, resting rate from Table 5-1 (p.70); this averaging is ShiftShield's derivation, not a printed NIOSH table. Values are rounded down to 0.1 C (stricter). The earlier Figure 8-1/8-2 chart readings are kept per row as chart_reading_cross_check_c. Not approved for field use.
water_guidance: NIOSH 2016-106 executive summary p. vi: one 8-oz cup of water or other fluid every 15–20 minutes; general source guidance, not individualized advice.
One 8-oz cup every 15–20 minutes (NIOSH 2016-106, executive summary, printed p. vi).

normal.label: A · NORMAL
normal.guidance: Normal work with standard breaks; drink regularly and keep heat awareness active.

caution.label: B · CAUTION
caution.guidance: 45 work / 15 rest each hour; provide a shaded rest area and buddy check at breaks.

high.label: C · HIGH
high.guidance: 30 work / 30 rest each hour; move heavy tasks to cooler hours.

very_high.label: D · VERY HIGH
very_high.guidance: 15 work / 45 rest each hour; stop non-essential heavy work.

normal.source: NIOSH 2016-106 Table 3-2, p.19; work clothing baseline

heavy.source: Conservative v7 profile mapping: partially air/vapor-impermeable ensemble correction; NIOSH pp.16–19. Not an exact mapping of generic 'heavy' PPE.

impermeable.source: NIOSH 2016-106 Table 3-2, p.19; limited-use vapor-barrier coverall. WBGT is not appropriate for fully impermeable encapsulating ensembles.

hysteresis.status: configurable engineering demo value; not a NIOSH medical limit

symptom_tightening.status: demo-only configurable value; requires field safety review
